title: research evaluation of innovations and strategies for organic farming – results from a survey at the organic field days in germany
core_idea: To assess stakeholder perceptions and acceptance of innovations and strategies for organic farming by surveying attendees at an organic farming fair, focusing on which innovations are considered acceptable, how important they are perceived to be, and which have the greatest development potential.
tldr: A survey-based study investigating how relevant stakeholders perceive, prioritize and accept different innovations and strategies for organic farming, aiming to inform future development directions and adaptation needs.
